fishing_poles.name: Alpha Angler
fishing_poles.description:
It's best not to think of just where the bones for this came from.

Capable of catching rare from pools in the obelisks of the Everdark.

fishing_poles.name: Basic Fishing Pole
fishing_poles.description: A beginner's pole. Can be bought from Saltwater Sam in Drowned Worlds.

fishing_poles.name: Candied Fishing Cane
fishing_poles.description: A sweet angling rod for fishing in chocolate. Can be made at the Nautical Assembler in Drowned Worlds.

fishing_poles.name: Carysian Caster
fishing_poles.description: The best fishing rod that Carysian Ducats can buy.

fishing_poles.name: Chaos Rod
fishing_poles.description: A fishing rod imbued with a touch of primordial chaos.

fishing_poles.name: Elysian Fishing Rod
fishing_poles.description:
Even warriors need to relax once in a while and just take in the scenery... even if it's too dark to see it.

Capable of catching rare from pools in the obelisks of the Everdark.

fishing_poles.name: Ferny Fisher
fishing_poles.description: Sure to hook fish with the gently waving fronds.

fishing_poles.name: Fish Finder
fishing_poles.description: Simply the best at finding most fish.

fishing_poles.name: Frenzied Fisher
fishing_poles.description: If it swims, shoot it.

fishing_poles.name: Irradiant Rod
fishing_poles.description: Is it actually catching fish or just confusing them in to surfacing?

fishing_poles.name: King Egon's Royal Angler
fishing_poles.description: Any and all Eggs or Trovians found in possession of this or any of King Egon's other royal possessions shall be subject to immediate execution. So says the King.

fishing_poles.name: Kiwi Katcher
fishing_poles.description: The real challenge is avoiding katching yourself.

fishing_poles.name: Lady of the Lake
fishing_poles.description: A legendary fishing rod said to enchant any fish that swims nearby. Can be made at the Nautical Assembler in Drowned Worlds.

fishing_poles.name: Master Angler's Rod
fishing_poles.description: A masterful fishing rod.

fishing_poles.name: Molten Magma Sifter
fishing_poles.description: A heat-resistant pole which unlocks fishing in lava. Can be made at the Nautical Assembler in Drowned Worlds.

fishing_poles.name: Murkwater Mark's Mucker
fishing_poles.description:
Can find any fish in even the muckiest of water or chocolate. 

Capable of catching the most elusive fish in the Depths from pools.

Sold by Murkwater Mark in the Fishing area of the Hub.

fishing_poles.name: N-0 Depth Scoper
fishing_poles.description: An advanced angling rod for fishing in plasma.

fishing_poles.name: Panatean Pole
fishing_poles.description: It's hard to fish if you're too busy partying.

fishing_poles.name: Pole of the Deep
fishing_poles.description: Despite Mark's claims, this pole absolutely can not fish up Leviathans.\n\nCapable of catching Rare Depths Fish from Water Pools found in Long Shade Difficulty (15).

fishing_poles.name: Royal Reeler
fishing_poles.description: No fish, great or small, can resist its allure.

fishing_poles.name: Turtle Trawler
fishing_poles.description:
I like turtles.  Turtles like pizza.  Somehow this results in catching fish.

Capable of catching invasive turtles from the Depths.

Sold by Mr. Thommas Tortoise.

fishing_poles.name: Tweeting Trawler
fishing_poles.description: Professional trawlers are often known for fishing using tools like this - sometimes it's known as chirping.

fishing_poles.name: Tysorion Trawler
fishing_poles.description: Fishing is easier when the fish just listen to your orders and jump into your boat.

fishing_poles.name: Wish Fisher
fishing_poles.description: A legendary fishing rod that makes any angler's wishes come true.
